name: KAIST public app QR and cross-app isolation
target: Run the real Nexus app-host request handler behind fake public-name resolution after fake deployment; keep app origins, session cookies, and per-app databases isolated.
inputs: separate owner sessions and one deliberately crossed session
observations: fake deployment serves both app artifacts
public QR names resolve only for valid HTTPS app hosts
the real Nexus app-host serves both public app origins
a session from one app is rejected by the other app
RPC rows remain isolated per app and browser storage is origin-scoped
